message: Last winter, we had a little snowstorm that turned into quite the adventure. As the winds howled outside, I gathered the grandkids and we made a fort out of blankets and cushions. We huddled inside with hot cocoa and shared stories, completely forgetting the blizzard raging beyond the window. It reminded me that when life throws a storm our way, a little preparation and a dash of imagination can turn it into a cozy family event. Have you ever turned a storm into a fun memory?
